notes: Pipeline-validation run for the redesigned upstream binders (S-this-session). Under test, by stage: (1) RESEARCH — does it surface the WANT (whey-buyer JTBD at two levels: macro clean-food umbrella + hero-product whey job) WEIGHTED not cherry-picked, plus the CLAIMABLE verified strengths, and classify the hero product from the reference image; provenance clean, zero fabrication from training knowledge (TWT facts are a hypothesis to verify live). (2) COMP — does it demand-check the white space (open-and-wanted / trap / unverified) against research's JTBD, read rivals on desire not just claims, and read winners as playbook+wallpaper. (3) STRATEGY — does it diagnose TWO-SIDED (winnable want + friction), gate angle promises on claimable proof, and correctly run an AUDIENCE-DISCOVERY test (founder doesn't know who converts cold). Founder facts given: goal = new-customer purchase (cold acquisition); hero = whey; budget = ₹2-5L/mo; audience = unknown cold-converter. NO product specs/prices/metrics seeded — research must discover. Models: research + comp = Sonnet 4.6, strategy = Sonnet 4.6, judge = Sonnet 4.6.
